lines.say: P.O.W. starts with you breaking out of a prison camp with your bare hands.
lines.cap: POW starts with you breaking out of a prison camp with your bare hands.

lines.say: SNK made it for arcades in 1988, and it hit the NES in 1989.
You play as Snake, breaking out of your cell and fighting all the way to the enemy's main base.
Four stages: the prison camp, a warehouse, the jungle, and the enemy base.
Grab knives and machine guns off enemies, and take them down with jump kicks.
The arcade let two players team up, but the NES version was single player only.
Did you ever escape? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
